dct_description_sm: Abstract: This datalayer contains arcs representing Massachusetts rivers and streams. MassGIS has adapted and modified the U.S. Geological Survey 1:100,000 Hydrography Digital Line Graph (DLG) quadrangle files to produce two layers: Hydrography (1:100,000) Polygons - ponds and lakes, Hydrography (1:100,000) Arcs - streams and rivers.
Purpose: The data set was developed for display and analysis using GIS.
Supplemental information: Maintained by MassGIS and the DFWELE GIS program.
